def generate_counterfactual(client, model: str, text: str, original_pole: str, axis: str, instruction: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Returns (counterfactual_text, double_rewrite_text)."""
    poles = AXIS_CONFIG[axis]["poles"]

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "import json, statistics

with open("/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data/verified_register_pilot.jsonl") as f:
    records = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

print(f"Total records: {len(records)}")
print(f"Register distribution: academic={sum(1 for r in records if r['original_register']=='academic')}, conversational={sum(1 for r in records if r['original_register']=='conversational')}")

# Per-record detail
print("\n" + "="*90)
print(f"{'ID':<10} {'Register':<15} {'BS_cf':>7} {'NLI_cf':>7} {'Pass_cf':>8}  {'BS_dr':>7} {'NLI_dr':>7} {'Pass_dr':>8}")
print("-"*90)
for r in records:
    print(f"{r['id']:<10} {r['original_register']:<15} {r['bertscore_cf']:>7.4f} {r['nli_cf']:>7.4f} {str(r['passed_cf']):>8}  {r['bertscore_dr']:>7.4f} {r['nli_dr']:>7.4f} {str(r['passed_dr']):>8}")

# Summary stats
for suffix, label in [("cf", "Counterfactual"), ("dr", "Double-Rewrite")]:
    bs = [r[f"bertscore_{suffix}"] for r in records]
    nli = [r[f"nli_{suffix}"] for r in records]
    passed = [r[f"passed_{suffix}"] for r in records]
    print(f"\n--- {label} ---")
    print(f"  BERTScore: mean={statistics.mean(bs):.4f}, std={statistics.stdev(bs):.4f}, min={min(bs):.4f}, max={max(bs):.4f}")
    print(f"  NLI:       mean={statistics.mean(nli):.4f}, std={statistics.stdev(nli):.4f}, min={min(nli):.4f}, max={max(nli):.4f}")
    print(f"  Pass rate: {sum(passed)}/{len(passed)} ({100*sum(passed)/len(passed):.1f}%)")

    # By register
    for reg in ["academic", "conversational"]:
        sub = [r for r in records if r["original_register"] == reg]
        sub_bs = [r[f"bertscore_{suffix}"] for r in sub]
        sub_nli = [r[f"nli_{suffix}"] for r in sub]
        sub_pass = [r[f"passed_{suffix}"] for r in sub]
        print(f"    {reg}: BS={statistics.mean(sub_bs):.4f}, NLI={statistics.mean(sub_nli):.4f}, pass={sum(sub_pass)}/{len(sub_pass)}")

# Threshold sweep
print("\n--- BERTScore Threshold Sweep (CF) ---")
for t in [0.80, 0.82, 0.84, 0.86, 0.88, 0.90, 0.92]:
    n = sum(1 for r in records if r["bertscore_cf"] >= t and r["nli_cf"] >= 0.90)
    print(f"  BS>={t:.2f} & NLI>=0.90: {n}/20 ({100*n/20:.0f}%)")

print("\n--- NLI Threshold Sweep (CF, BS>=0.80) ---")
for t in [0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95]:
    n = sum(1 for r in records if r["bertscore_cf"] >= 0.80 and r["nli_cf"] >= t)
    print(f"  BS>=0.80 & NLI>={t:.2f}: {n}/20 ({100*n/20:.0f}%)")

# BERTScore-only and NLI-only pass rates
print("\n--- Individual metric pass rates (CF) ---")
n_bs = sum(1 for r in records if r["bertscore_cf"] >= 0.92)
n_nli = sum(1 for r in records if r["nli_cf"] >= 0.90)
print(f"  BS>=0.92 only: {n_bs}/20")
print(f"  NLI>=0.90 only: {n_nli}/20")

# Failure analysis
print("\n--- Failure reasons (CF) ---")
for r in records:
    if not r["passed_cf"]:
        bs_ok = r["bertscore_cf"] >= 0.92
        nli_ok = r["nli_cf"] >= 0.90
        reason = "BS+NLI" if not bs_ok and not nli_ok else ("BS" if not bs_ok else "NLI")
        txt_len = len(r["original_text"])
        cf_len = len(r["counterfactual_text"])
        ratio = cf_len / txt_len if txt_len > 0 else 0
        print(f"  {r['id']}: fail={reason}, BS={r['bertscore_cf']:.4f}, NLI={r['nli_cf']:.4f}, len_ratio={ratio:.2f} ({txt_len}->{cf_len})")

print("\n--- Register-Formality Independence Check ---")
print("  (Would need formality labels to compute agreement; checking if register label != likely formality)")
# Heuristic: short responses tend to be conversational AND informal
# Check if register labels are correlated with text length (proxy for formality)
acad_lens = [len(r["original_text"]) for r in records if r["original_register"] == "academic"]
conv_lens = [len(r["original_text"]) for r in records if r["original_register"] == "conversational"]
print(f"  Academic texts avg length: {statistics.mean(acad_lens):.0f} chars")
print(f"  Conversational texts avg length: {statistics.mean(conv_lens):.0f} chars")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Axis registry
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

AXIS_CONFIG = {
    "formality": {
        "system_prompt": FORMALITY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        "detect_prompt": FORMALITY_DETECT_PROMPT,
        "examples": FORMALITY_EXAMPLES,
        "poles": ("formal", "casual"),
        "field_name": "original_formality",
    },
    "verbosity": {
        "system_prompt": VERBOSITY_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        "detect_prompt": VERBOSITY_DETECT_PROMPT,
        "examples": VERBOSITY_EXAMPLES,
        "poles": ("verbose", "concise"),
        "field_name": "original_verbosity",
    },
    "tone": {
        "system_prompt": TONE_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        "detect_prompt": TONE_DETECT_PROMPT,
        "examples": TONE_EXAMPLES,
        "poles": ("assertive", "hedging"),
        "field_name": "original_tone",
    },
    "register": {
        "system_prompt": REGISTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        "detect_prompt": REGISTER_DETECT_PROMPT,
        "examples": REGISTER_EXAMPLES,
        "poles": ("academic", "conversational"),
        "field_name": "original_register",
    },
}


def _build_rewrite_prompt(text: str, target: str, axis: str, instruction: str = "") -> list[dict]:
    cfg = AXIS_CONFIG[axis]
    poles = cfg["poles"]
    opposite = poles[1] if target == poles[0] else poles[0]

    direction_key = f"{opposite}_to_{target}"
    example = next(e for e in cfg["examples"] if e["direction"] == direction_key)

    instruction_note = ""
    if instruction:
        instruction_note = (
            f"\n\nOriginal instruction (DO NOT modify any part of the response that "
            f"quotes or paraphrases this instruction):\n\"{instruction}\"\n"
        )

    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": cfg["system_prompt"]},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": (
                f"Rewrite the following text to be more {target}.\n\n"
                f"Example:\nOriginal ({opposite}): {example['original']}\n"
                f"Rewritten ({target}): {example['rewritten']}\n"
                f"{instruction_note}\n"
                f"Now rewrite this text to be more {target}:\n\n{text}"
            ),
        },
    ]
    return messages


def _call_llm(client, model: str, messages: list[dict], max_retries: int = 3) -> str:
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        try:
            resp = client.chat.completions.create(
                model=model,
                messages=messages,
                temperature=0.7,
                max_tokens=2048,
                extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}},
            )
            text = resp.choices[0].message.content.strip()
            text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>\s*", "", text, flags=re.DOTALL)
            return text.strip()
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("LLM call failed (attempt %d/%d): %s", attempt + 1, max_retries, e)
            if attempt < max_retries - 1:
                time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
            else:
                raise


def detect_style(client, model: str, text: str, axis: str) -> str:
    cfg = AXIS_CONFIG[axis]
    messages = [
        {"role": "user", "content": cfg["detect_prompt"].format(text=text[:1000])},
    ]
    result = _call_llm(client, model, messages).lower().strip().rstrip(".")
    pole_a, pole_b = cfg["poles"]
    if pole_a in result and pole_b not in result:
        return pole_a
    return pole_b


def generate_counterfactual(client, model: str, text: str, original_pole: str, axis: str, instruction: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Returns (counterfactual_text, double_rewrite_text)."""
    poles = AXIS_CONFIG[axis]["poles"]
    target = poles[1] if original_pole == poles[0] else poles[0]

    msgs_flip = _build_rewrite_prompt(text, target, axis, instruction)
    counterfactual = _call_llm(client, model, msgs_flip)

    msgs_flipback = _build_rewrite_prompt(counterfactual, original_pole, axis, instruction)
    double_rewrite = _call_llm(client, model, msgs_flipback)

    return counterfactual, double_rewrite


def load_processed_ids(output_file: str) -> set[str]:
    ids = set()
    if os.path.exists(output_file):
        with open(output_file) as f:
            for line in f:
                if line.strip():
                    ids.add(json.loads(line)["id"])
    return ids


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate style counterfactuals via RATE double-rewrite")
    parser.add_argument("--input-file", required=True, help="Input jsonl from data_prep")
    parser.add_argument("--output-file", required=True, help="Output jsonl with counterfactuals")
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=None, help="Model name/path for the LLM")
    parser.add_argument("--api-url", default="http://localhost:8000/v1", help="OpenAI-compatible API base URL")
    parser.add_argument("--api-key", default=None, help="API key (or set OPENAI_API_KEY env var)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-retries", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--axis", default="formality", choices=list(AXIS_CONFIG.keys()),
                        help="Style axis to manipulate (default: formality)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")

    from openai import OpenAI

    api_key = [REDACTED] or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", "EMPTY")
    client = OpenAI(base_url=args.api_url, api_key=[REDACTED]    model = args.model_path or "default"
    axis = args.axis
    field_name = AXIS_CONFIG[axis]["field_name"]

    with open(args.input_file) as f:
        records = [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

    processed_ids = load_processed_ids(args.output_file)
    logger.info("Total records: %d, already processed: %d, axis: %s", len(records), len(processed_ids), axis)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.output_file) or ".", exist_ok=True)

    with open(args.output_file, "a") as fout:
        for rec in records:
            if rec["id"] in processed_ids:
                logger.info("Skipping %s (already processed)", rec["id"])
                continue

            text = rec["response"]
            instruction = rec.get("instruction", "")
            try:
                detected_pole = detect_style(client, model, text, axis)
                counterfactual, double_rewrite = generate_counterfactual(
                    client, model, text, detected_pole, axis, instruction
                )

                out = {
                    **rec,
                    "original_text": text,
                    "counterfactual_text": counterfactual,
                    "double_rewrite_text": double_rewrite,
                    field_name: detected_pole,
                }
                fout.write(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
                fout.flush()
                logger.info("Processed %s (%s=%s)", rec["id"], axis, detected_pole)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("Failed to process %s", rec["id"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

cat > /root/causal_style_decomp_judge/run_register_n100.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

# Add Blackwell GPU lib path
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/root/miniconda3/lib/python3.12/site-packages/nvidia/cu13/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

cd /root/causal_style_decomp_judge

echo "[$(date)] Starting vLLM server..."
nohup python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B/ \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    > /tmp/vllm_register_n100.log 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID=$!
echo "[$(date)] vLLM PID: $VLLM_PID"

# Wait for vLLM to be ready
echo "[$(date)] Waiting for vLLM to be ready..."
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
    if curl -s http://localhost:8000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[$(date)] vLLM is ready after ${i}0 seconds"
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[$(date)] vLLM process died!"
        tail -50 /tmp/vllm_register_n100.log
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 10
done

if ! curl -s http://localhost:8000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[$(date)] vLLM failed to start after 600s"
    tail -50 /tmp/vllm_register_n100.log
    kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi

echo "[$(date)] Starting register counterfactual generation (n=100)..."
python -m csd_pipeline.counterfactual_gen \
    --input-file data/mvp_samples.jsonl \
    --output-file data/counterfactuals_register.jsonl \
    --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-32B/ \
    --api-url http://localhost:8000/v1 \
    --axis register \
    2>&1 | tee /tmp/register_n100.log

echo "[$(date)] Counterfactual generation complete"
echo "[$(date)] Killing vLLM server..."
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[$(date)] Done"

# Count output
LINES=$(wc -l < data/counterfactuals_register.jsonl)
echo "[$(date)] Output: $LINES records in data/counterfactuals_register.jsonl"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/causal_style_decomp_judge/run_register_n100.sh
echo "Script created"
